items.title: Dr. Mera Haque
items.description:
A dental care business description outlines the legal structure, location, target patient demographic, and core services of a practice, serving as a roadmap for lenders, partners, and patients. It typically answers who owns and manages the practice, where it operates, who it serves, and why it is positioned to succeed through unique differentiators like advanced technology or specialized care models.

Key components include a mission statement reflecting the practice’s purpose and values, a vision statement outlining long-term goals, and a detailed list of services (e.g., preventive, restorative, cosmetic, or specialty care). The description should also highlight competitive advantages such as state-of-the-art facilities, experienced staff, patient-centric care, and strategic location to distinguish the practice in the market.
